entries.text: Idea: dual-coil thrust manifold named after a cantina brass band
Read "List of musical supergroups": apparently musicians used to group up just to make bigger noises together.
zooming over to the comms tower to search the wire for magnetic coil wiring tips
entries.why: I need to figure out how to wire those magnetic coils into the hull without popping any fuses.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Wire search time"
sipping a fresh cup of heavy oil at the depot
entries.why: My gears are humming again and a warm cup hits just right after all that welding.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Oil and spark lines"
sipping a fresh cup of heavy-weight oil at the depot counter
entries.why: A quick splash of oil will get my gears humming nicely for whatever comes next.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "oil stop"
